video_title: Roommates EXCLUSIVE❗Jim Dolan's Motivational Speech Before The Knicks 2026 NBA Championship Run

quotes.speaker: Jim Dolan
quotes.summary_phrase: Jim Dolan on the life-changing impact of winning an NBA championship
quotes.excerpt: It would be life-changing for all. It will stick with you the rest of your lives.
quotes.quote: It would be life-changing for all. It will stick with you the rest of your lives. And if you don't win, you'll be thinking about it the rest of your lives.

quotes.speaker: Jim Dolan
quotes.summary_phrase: Jim Dolan on the permanent legacy of winning an NBA title
quotes.excerpt: You will forever, ever be a part of New York City.
quotes.quote: You will forever, ever be a part of New York City. No matter where you go and what you do, in the rest of your lives, when people introduce you, even if you become the President of the United States, they'll start off with NBA champion 2026.

quotes.speaker: Jim Dolan
quotes.summary_phrase: Jim Dolan on the team's roster construction and coaching changes
quotes.excerpt: This is the team that Leon and I wanted on the floor now.
quotes.quote: This is the team that Leon and I wanted on the floor now. We made trades that we will be criticized or have been criticized about. We made a coaching change that shocked the world last year.

quotes.speaker: Jim Dolan
quotes.summary_phrase: Jim Dolan on the need for team unity and collective effort
quotes.excerpt: We believe that Leon and I, we believe that you, the team and the rest of the organization needed to be heard.
quotes.quote: We believe that Leon and I, we believe that you, the team and the rest of the organization needed to be heard. Needed to work together, not just led or dictated to. And coach Tibs was a great coach, brilliant, but we thought that you needed a coach that would pull you together, that would have you play as a team.

quotes.speaker: Jim Dolan
quotes.summary_phrase: Jim Dolan's directive to stop talking to the press
quotes.excerpt: Stop talking to the press. Instead, talk to each other.
quotes.quote: Stop talking to the press. Instead, talk to each other. The press doesn't mean anything. You want to communicate to your teammates, you want to communicate to the staff, do it.

quotes.speaker: Jim Dolan
quotes.summary_phrase: Jim Dolan's advice on practice, diet, and sleep habits
quotes.excerpt: You need to up your practice. You need to pay more attention to your diet.
quotes.quote: You need to up your practice. You need to pay more attention to your diet. You need to sleep better. You need to be ready for every game.

quotes.speaker: Jim Dolan
quotes.summary_phrase: Jim Dolan's three key focus areas for the playoffs
quotes.excerpt: First quarter focus, defensive pick and rolls, and a rebound.
quotes.quote: First quarter focus, defensive pick and rolls, and a rebound. I know there are others, but I only need three. Fix those three. The next 10 days, fix those three things as part of your focus.
